content.short: Ionian is a full-stack data storage protocol for Web3.
content.description: Ionian is a full-stack data storage protocol. It includes several storage layers to optimize performance and a transaction processing layer where dApps update their data. It also provides a key-value store to tap into other decentralized file systems, and its log layer acts as the permaweb.
content.meta: Ionian is a full-stack data storage protocol. Discover Ionian and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
